title: Mi Upgrader
description: Yet another <positive>revolutionary invention</positive> from the "Things that one person asked for and we spent quite some time bringing them to life" department of <named>PLACERS™</named> - the almighty <named>FINGMER</named> (Functionally Irreversible Neatly Game-designed Machine and whatever Else Replacer).
